<html lang="fr"><head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Bless Univers – Concept Store</title>
<meta name="description" content="Bless Univers Concept Store : mode africaine, senteurs &amp; bougies, bijoux &amp; accessoires, maison &amp; déco. Akanda – Sherko, Gabon.">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#FAF6EE">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@500;600;700&amp;display=swap">
<style>
:root{--bg:#FAF6EE;--card:#fff;--ink:#4a3a22;--muted:#8a7650;--gold:#B8862F;--line:#E8DCC4;--onGold:#fff;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#17120c;--card:#221b12;--ink:#f3e9d6;--muted:#b9a57c;--gold:#D9AE5A;--line:#3a2f1e;--onGold:#17120c}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#17120c;--card:#221b12;--ink:#f3e9d6;--muted:#b9a57c;--gold:#D9AE5A;--line:#3a2f1e;--onGold:#17120c}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif;font-size:18px}
main{max-width:420px;margin:0 auto;padding:28px 20px 40px;text-align:center}
.logo{display:block;width:100%;max-width:280px;height:auto;margin:0 auto}
.rule{width:64px;height:2px;background:var(--gold);margin:18px auto}
.cats{color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:14px;line-height:1.8;margin:0}
.btn{display:block;padding:14px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--gold);color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none;font-size:17px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin:10px 0;transition:background .2s,color .2s}
.btn:hover,.btn:focus-visible{background:var(--gold);color:var(--onGold);outline:none}
.btn.primary{background:var(--gold);color:var(--onGold)}
.btn.primary:hover,.btn.primary:focus-visible{filter:brightness(1.08)}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:22px 18px;margin:26px 0 18px}
.card h2{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:24px;color:var(--gold)}
.card p{margin:0 0 14px;line-height:1.45}
.card .btn{margin-bottom:0}
.addr{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5;margin-top:22px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
